Spot the Rejection

Brief: “Rexa’s LIVE · /rexalive badge must be visible and unchanged for the whole clip.”

Which clip will fail the campaign brief?

Crop A fails.

The centre crop cuts off the required LIVE · /rexalive overlay. The fix: use a stacked layout, so the full frame (overlay included) stays on screen.

“Rexa Live” is a fictional practice case. Real-world rule like this one: “Every clip must include KreekCraft’s overlay”, from the KreekCraft GTA 6 Clipping brief on Content Rewards (checked 19 Nov 2026).
